scientific_question: Is the x-y-conditioned vertical organization of European free-tailed bat flight altitude temporally repeatable within individuals but poorly transferable among individuals?

relationship_to_odsp.source_endpoint: odsp N2 European free-tailed bat terminal result
relationship_to_odsp.purpose: mechanism follow-up explaining non-transferability, not rescue or independent replication

temporal_split.rule: Within each individual, sort eligible finite events by timestamp and assign the first floor(n/2) events to early and the remaining events to late.

probability_model.species_conditional: Equal-individual mean of Jeffreys-smoothed early P_i(z|cell) among individuals represented in each cell.
probability_model.species_marginal: Equal-individual mean of Jeffreys-smoothed early P_i(z) across individuals.
probability_model.individualized_conditional: For source individual i and cell c, shrink i's early raw z counts toward species P(z|c) with fixed equivalent sample size lambda; if i has no early event in c, use species P(z|c).
probability_model.individualized_marginal: Shrink i's all-cell early z counts toward species P(z) with the same lambda.

primary_test.score_matrix: For each source individual i and target individual j, mean late-event log P_i(z|cell) on target j, relative to the matched species P(z|cell) baseline.
primary_test.observed_statistic: Unweighted mean of diagonal source==target gains across the eight target individuals.
primary_test.null: Enumerate all 8! permutations assigning early individual maps to late target identities.
primary_test.one_sided_p: fraction of all permutations with mean assigned gain >= observed diagonal mean.
primary_test.support_rule: p <= 0.05 and at least 6 of 8 diagonal individual gains > 0

decomposition.total_identity_advantage: own conditional P_i(z|cell) minus species conditional P_species(z|cell)
decomposition.marginal_identity_advantage: own marginal P_i(z) minus species marginal P_species(z)
decomposition.within_individual_spatial_increment: own conditional P_i(z|cell) minus own marginal P_i(z)

interpretation_rule.individual_specific_spatial_strategy: primary test passes and at least 5 of 8 within-individual spatial increments are >0
interpretation_rule.individual_specific_altitude_without_spa: primary test passes, fewer than 5 spatial increments >0, and at least 5 of 8 marginal identity advantages are >0

allowed: temporal repeatability of individual-specific vertical-state prediction within the frozen horizontal cells
cross-individual transfer asymmetry under the fixed MSL altitude axis
individual specialization as a statistical description if the frozen rule passes
prohibited: reinterpretation of the original ODSP endpoint as successful transfer
